notes: v1 domains are never converted automatically. This table explains how earlier tracking relates to DSM items.

sleep.note: The v1 direction decides: reduced/increased → MDE.A4/PDD.B2; reduced need without fatigue → MANIA.B2; disrupted with worry → GAD.C6.

energy.note: GAD.C2 only when linked to worry.

self_worth.note: v1 merged guilt and self-esteem; DSM separates them.

psychomotor.note: Observable slowing or agitation → MDE.A5; felt restlessness → GAD.C1/ANXD.2.

irritability.note: A distinct irritable period → MANIA.A/HYPO.A; ongoing irritability with worry → GAD.C4.

increased_goal_directed_activity_risky_b.note: Split; the energy part belongs to criterion A.

social_fear_avoidance.note: Split: fear → SAD.A–C; avoidance → SAD.D. Avoidance alone is not SAD.A.

social_functioning.note: No DSM symptom equivalent: impairment evidence for each condition's impairment criterion.

academic_work_functioning.note: No DSM symptom equivalent: impairment evidence.

self_care.note: No DSM symptom equivalent: impairment evidence.
